Church of Santa Maria della Vittoria

Site · Mantua, Italy

This episode is also referenced in a canvas that was used for the new church and later transferred to the Basilica of Sant’Andrea (second chapel on the right). The painting shows a Madonna and Child, to whom San Girolamo is proffering the model of the church itself; at their feet is a group of four Jews – thought to be the Norsa family – with an afflicted expression, bearing a yellow circle on their clothes. This was the distinguishing mark that the Jewish population was made to wear at the time.
